The '''Cularin Arms Apartment Complex''' was an apartment complex that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The complex was situated near to a warehouse and an old wood-processing plant.
